name: sudden-claude
description: Round-based team elimination FPS in the browser. Procedural everything, no art assets, no netcode.

scripts.test: npm run test:logic && npm run test:render && npm run test:perf
scripts.test:logic: npm run lint && node tools/layering.mjs && node tools/headless.mjs && node tools/cmdstream.mjs && node tools/replay.mjs && node tools/reach.mjs && node tools/navsanity.mjs && node tools/symmetry.mjs && node tools/playtest.mjs && node tools/hitbox.mjs && node tools/vault.mjs && node tools/botfight.mjs && node tools/matchsim.mjs && node tools/hud.mjs && node tools/roundreset.mjs && node tools/debris.mjs && node tools/phasecue.mjs && node tools/ballistics.mjs && node tools/threat.mjs && node tools/firerate.mjs && node tools/aim.mjs && node tools/perceive.mjs
scripts.test:render: npm run test:legibility && npm run test:legibility:clutter && npm run test:markings && npm run test:friendfoe && npm run test:pixelgate && npm run test:crossengine && npm run test:determinism
scripts.test:crossengine: for s in 0x5eed1234 1 424242 1519997492; do node tools/crossengine.mjs --gate --engines=chromium,firefox,webkit --ticks=3600 --seed=$s || exit 1; done
